cohort: Mothers of preterm infants with very low birth weight (VLBW) were followed during the first 3 years after delivery.
finding: Mothers of preterm infants with VLBW exhibited transient improvements in physical well-being during the first year, but depressive symptoms, posthemorrhagic hydrocephalus, and bronchopulmonary dysplasia were negatively associated with QoL, while social, religious, and economic factors were also important.
